alternatives.name: actionlint
alternatives.why_not_default: Native execution detected an invalid workflow expression and passed after correction. Valuable complementary syntax checking, but it does not supply runtime inventory or publication attribution; zizmor more directly covers workflow security within the three-winner limit.

alternatives.name: Trivy
alternatives.why_not_default: Although marked adopted in the packet, its retained source review defers execution pending SBOM and vulnerability-database freshness policy. No executed Trivy comparison establishes coverage or actionable findings.

alternatives.name: Dependabot
alternatives.why_not_default: Initial hosted scans succeeded and opened two major-update proposals whose unreviewed hashes blocked integration. This supports update maintenance, but weekly timing and nonempty minor/patch grouping remain unobserved, and it does not establish inventory or artifact provenance.

alternatives.name: gitleaks
alternatives.why_not_default: Retained native controls support scoped secret detection. The newer hosted history scan timed out; subsequent coverage excludes large generated HTML, and the documentation retains an unresolved finding on a sibling branch. Secret detection complements the selected three but cannot replace inventory, workflow-permission analysis or publication attribution.

alternatives.name: Grype
alternatives.why_not_default: Newer retained execution exceeds the packet's source-review classification: scans of 21 installed runtime packages and two declared adapter pins returned zero matches against the recorded database. This adds bounded vulnerability matching, not replacement coverage for the selected capabilities; positive detection, actionable remediation and a blocking threshold remain unestablished. It remains non-adopted under the packet's eligibility rule.

limits: This verdict reviews retained evidence; no native scan, hosted workflow, artifact download or comparison was rerun.
Private raw SBOMs and their underlying runtime directories were not inspected; inventory conclusions rely on sanitized retained receipts.
Live GitHub enforcement and artifact availability were not verified. Historical publication acceptance does not qualify the newer tag-triggered and SBOM-attestation changes.
Documentation contains differing historical and prospective automation states; claims are restricted to explicitly recorded executions and revisions.
open_gaps: The three winners cover complementary requirements; no executed comparison establishes that this combination is globally superior to every alternative.
Syft's installed-package inventory excludes external interpreters, host libraries and complete vendored-native-library discovery; its release signature was not verified.
zizmor acceptance covers offline regular-persona analysis. The unsafe fixture is inert synthetic input, and successful analysis does not execute workflows.
Publication provenance establishes origin and byte integrity for the named historical commit, not reproducible builds, catalog correctness or current publication behavior.
Complete dependency locking and ongoing update ownership are not established across every runtime; Dependabot's scheduled timing and grouped-update behavior remain unobserved.
The Grype scan establishes a dated zero-match result, not vulnerability absence, positive-detection sensitivity or remediation quality.

arms: Incumbent: zizmor workflow-security checks, Syft installed-runtime inventory and GitHub Actions attest publication verification.

Challenger: a candidate substitution or addition evaluated against the same workflow controls, installed-package metadata and publication identity/tamper checks; compare Trivy and Grype on identical SBOM bytes with recorded database provenance.
overturn_protocol.metric: Require successful clean controls and unsafe-input rejection with no skipped native tests, exact installed-package name/version agreement, valid original and rejected altered publication artifacts, and any claimed additional vulnerability coverage supported by reproducible findings and reviewed fix applicability.

overturn_when: Reconsider if python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_workflow_security fails a clean or unsafe control without skips, or replay of the native inventory procedure in blueprints/us-equities/supply-chain/README.md exposes an installed-package omission. Replace a winner only after an executed alternative comparison closes that demonstrated gap while retaining the other required capabilities; vulnerability additions require identical SBOM inputs and recorded database provenance.
why_selected: Select Syft, GitHub Actions attest and zizmor as the strongest complementary coverage within the three-candidate limit. Native Syft execution in blueprints/us-equities/supply-chain/receipt.json matched all 36 installed distributions and agreed across Syft/CycloneDX package identities. Native zizmor execution in evidence/receipts/native-linux-zizmor-20260920.json accepted the published workflows and rejected an inert synthetic unsafe fixture with three diagnostics; both acceptance tests passed without skips. Hosted publication recorded in catalogs/foundation/automation.json and docs/catalog-provenance.md established independent download digest equality and original/altered/original verification outcomes of 0/1/0 for the named commit. Project-local SHA pins, scoped publication permissions and attributed required checks support these tools; their configuration is not itself additional upstream acceptance.
